Locomotion uses the platform’s existing 3D physics and skeletal playback. It samples one
controller result per fixed step and reuses the model’s existing pose sampling and animation
LOD. Gameplay supplies input, the physics controller moves the character, and the existing
pose modifiers handle procedural adjustments such as foot IK.

tree. A node is preserved only when the new node and old node describe the same identity and the new node can update the old node. Preserved nodes keep their
, focus state, in-flight animation controllers, layers, and other node-local runtime state. Recreated nodes start with fresh runtime state.

Give a 3D camera a physically based sky. The atmosphere scatters the sun’s light
the way air does, so the sky turns from blue at noon to orange near the horizon
and dark at night, the sun appears as a disc that the air reddens, and distant
geometry fades into haze.
